crossRefs.note: Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: Consider your ways.
I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you…

translations.web: This is what Yahweh of Armies says: “Consider your ways.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Consider your ways.
